label: Game I
nuance_found: Steering decides whether the marker on the RAM / OUT OF REACH bar sits in the yellow band against the rammer (Barnacle), and you then have to start the couch hold as the gold ring closes. Too early and the rival braces, too late and you lose footing. It is a real choice but there is one obvious best line.
audio: Regatta music loops (a few variants, changes per round), wind ambience, horn at the start of each tilt, lance crack and thud on hits, gasp or cheer stings, a victory sting, a defeat sting. Effects were satisfying and changed with play.
control_trouble: Timing the couch hold with 0.5 s looks was guesswork, so several 'too early' results were probably mine. Fine steering nudges on the slider were also coarse.
best_moment: Both lances cracking with a big BOTH HIT and the splinters flying, then beating Pip with the victory sting and 'Bath time' line.
worst_moment: Losing 'too early' on a hold I thought I timed to the ring, then being rammed by Barnacle with no clear way to fix it, so the second rival felt unfair.
verdict: Looks gorgeous and the hits sound great. The first rival is a nice easy win in about 100 seconds and I got it right away. Each round is the same thing though: wait about 6 seconds, then hold a button at the right moment. The second guy beat me and the game kept saying 'too early' when I thought I was on the ring, and I could not tell what I was doing wrong. The steer slider and bar were barely explained. I would give it one more try on the bus, but I would not be back this week unless the timing felt fairer.
